verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that shell integration lets iTerm2 know where each shell prompt is and lets you navigate to previous prompts with ⇧⌘↑/⇧⌘↓ (iterm2-docs-31, iterm2-docs-9). The GitHub README confirms marks at each prompt and that Copy Mode works with marks to jump between command prompts (iterm2-gh-10, iterm2-gh-8). Setup is a single settings toggle (iterm2-docs-24). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of prompt/mark navigation, and in-depth documentation of jumping between non-prompt command marks (e.g., trigger-set marks).
